_doc: Bodies falling together lie one on the other (specification 003 T008, Pwalkers-9): in shoot_test's town (seed 7), a blow of force 3 four metres west of the heart of the densest crowd (the walker with the most others within 5 m: {crowd, off}, LookArgs), which throws the crowd east together (a blow in its middle would throw them apart); four seconds after it the census and the bodies' places, and again ten seconds later (all at rest, none sunk in another: overlap); then the two bodies lying nearest one another (setViewNear pair) near (90 px a metre) from 40 degrees at four azimuths, at street level (12 degrees), from above (80) and mid (25): limbs on limbs, none sunk in the other.
